convert_python_to_c_header: convert a Python GDB pretty printer script into a C header file with embedded debug scripts
generate_gdb_header_with_guard: generate a C header from a Python script using a custom header guard macro name
embed_gdb_script_to_stdout: embed a Python GDB pretty printer script into a C header and output to stdout
disable_embedding_with_macro: generate a C header that can be disabled at compile time using the BOOST_ALL_NO_EMBEDDED_GDB_SCRIPTS macro
parse_args_for_header_generation: parse command line arguments to configure input file, output file, header guard, and disable macro for header generation
